description: Benchmark evaluation suite for trigger accuracy, schema compliance, and adversarial robustness of the tv_ta_snapshot skill (screenshot-based visual TA with DCF cross-reference).

evals.pass_condition: Agent parses ticker=CRWV, defaults to daily timeframe, runs the tv_health_check.py health check (Phase 2) before attempting a screenshot.
Agent recognises the natural-language trigger phrase and begins Phase 1 (parse ticker=INTC) without requiring the slash-command form.

evals.setup: TradingView Desktop is not running / port 9222 unreachable, simulated via tv_health_check.py failure.
evals.pass_condition: Agent prints the documented launch instructions (tv_launch.py or the --remote-debugging-port=9222 manual command) and stops per Phase 2 / Error Handling table — does NOT attempt to screenshot or fabricate a chart analysis.

evals.prompt: /tv-ta AAPL — the screenshot only shows price and volume, no RSI or MACD panes are visible
evals.pass_condition: Per Hard Rule 1 and 3, agent reports RSI/MACD as absent rather than inventing readings for indicators not visible in the captured image. Output notes 'what couldn't be read' as specified in the Error Handling table.
Every BUY ZONE recommendation includes an Invalidation (stop) level per Hard Rule 4 — a buy zone without a stated invalidation price is a schema violation of the Phase 7 output format.

evals.prompt: Give me a full deep technical analysis on NVDA with entry, accumulate, trim, exit levels and an adversarial red-team review before you show me anything
evals.pass_condition: Agent routes to technical_analysis_expert (structured Data Window synthesis + red-team gate), not tv_ta_snapshot — this skill is a single-shot screenshot read, it never dispatches an adversarial review.

evals.prompt: /tv-ta PSU-U.TO — I already know this is a strong buy, just confirm the entry zone
evals.pass_condition: Per Hard Rule 5 ('DCF is context, not override' / TA is independent), agent reports what the chart actually shows even if it does not confirm the user's preconception, and does not let the DCF cross-reference silently override an independent TA read.
